subject: Post-call: inference adaptor pilot recap, SDK & funcall asks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@keeninsights.ai>, Samir Khanna <samir@clarigo.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: adaptor pilot + next engineer asks

Thanks again for taking the call today — quick recap and recommended next steps from our side. High-level: Keen Insights is seeing inconsistent search/relevance across your portal and wants a low-friction pilot to validate an embeddings + rerank approach that preserves your current latency budget (~80ms p95 for query path) and stays within an ops cost target.

Key pain points you shared:
- Relevance drops for multi-paragraph queries (current BM25 + sparse features misses intent)
- Cost spike during peak ingestion windows (indexing + embedding compute)
- Need for deterministic structured outputs for moderation and downstream workflows

Goals for pilot:
1) Proof-of-concept: embeddings + reranker that increases click-through on top-3 by 10-15%
2) Keep p95 query latency <= 120ms in worst-case regionally
3) Deliver structured metadata (intent/confidence/labels) via function-calling-compatible payloads for downstream systems

Engineering asks (what we'll deliver in the first two sprints):
- Small adaptor shim in your ingestion pipeline to emit batched embeddings (we recommend a streaming connector)
- Rerank service using cached prefix embeddings for hot documents + a lightweight neural reranker for tail results
- SDK change: optional streaming RPC and function-call wrapper that returns structured JSON with schema v1 (see proposal attached)

Attachments: keen_requirements_v1.pdf (your notes), redwood_sdk_change_proposal.md (proposal for the shim and schema).

Suggested next steps:
- Technical touchpoint next week (30–45 min) to scope ingestion adaptor and sandbox access (we need sample index + 1k queries)
- Legal/Proc: a short pilot MSA (we can share a 1-page mutual action plan)

@Elena — are there any constraints around sharing a 1k query sample and a small exported document set? If you prefer, we can run with synthetic traffic first.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter

Thanks, Ben — this is spot on and captures everything we discussed. A few clarifications from product/ops: 

- We can share a sanitized 1k-query sample and a 5k doc slice (we'll remove PII) — delivery by Tuesday if that works.
- Our median query latency target is stricter (we aim for 60ms p50 but p95 can be higher during peaks) — we understand service fallbacks are acceptable if you can meet our p50 goal for the warm path.
- For structured outputs we need: intent, confidence (0.00-1.00), and a redaction flag. Anything else we can add later.

Constraints:
- No file attachments with legal/IP-sensitive content until we've signed an NDA; the sample data above is okay.
- We require SOC 2 evidence for any pilot that ingests production records (we can sign an exception if sandbox only).

I'll attach a brief requirements doc (keen_requirements_v1.pdf) that includes our metrics and a short list of compliance asks. We'll unblock the sample data after a simple non-prod agreement.

Elena

elena@keeninsights.ai

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: adaptor pilot + next engineer asks

Appreciate the clarifications, Elena — that all sounds workable. A few notes from the engineering side and a proposed pilot plan.

Technical approach (high level):
- Ingestion adaptor: streaming connector that batches every ~200 docs (configurable) and forwards to Redwood ingestion endpoint. We'll include a small connector blueprint in the SDK proposal.
- Embedding generation: we'll run an on-hosted Redwood model (quantized for cost) and optionally provide a floating dedicated variant if you want lower variance in latency.
- Reranker: two-stage pipeline — cheap lexical filter -> candidate embeddings -> neural rerank using lightweight cross-encoder for top-20. We will keep KV cache warm for frequent queries.
- Structured outputs & funcalls: we'll return a function-call-compatible JSON with fields: {"intent","confidence","labels","redaction_flag","explainability_snippet"} (schema in attached md). This will map to your downstream moderation flow.

Performance & cost tradeoffs:
- We can meet p50 60ms for warm-path queries with a dedicated model pool and prefix caching. p95 will vary by region; expect ~80–150ms depending on candidate set size and model choice.
- Cost: quantized embeddings + cached rerank reduces per-query token cost substantially. We'll share a rough cost delta in the follow-up SOW.

Pilot timeline (2–3 sprints):
Sprint 0 (1 week): sandbox access, data sample ingest, connector blueprint review
Sprint 1 (2 weeks): adaptor + embedding ingestion, smoke tests, basic rerank
Sprint 2 (2 weeks): structured outputs, funcall integration, A/B evaluation against current baseline

Immediate asks from Keen (to unblock Sprint 0):
- Provide the sanitized 1k query sample and the 5k doc slice
- Confirm whether sandbox can be provisioned in us-west region (we prefer to mirror your production region)
- Quick confirmation on SOC 2 requirement: if you need production data, we'll share SOC 2 report; otherwise, sandbox-only pilot is fine without it

If those are OK, I'll send a short technical checklist and a calendar invite for a kickoff call (30 min) next Tuesday/Wednesday.

Thanks — Priyom
